The pronoun "he" refers to the person standing in front of the door.  
The sentence structure suggests that "he" most logically refers to "the mechanic," since the mechanic is the subject performing the action (greets) and is likely the one positioned in front of the door to greet the receptionist.  
There is no indication that the receptionist is male or that "he" refers to the receptionist.  

Final answer: (A)
